issue: DistantHorizonsStandalone #67 - Mineshot Camera with DH and Angelica — terrain disappears

findings.summary: Mineshot camera mod causes terrain to disappear when used with DH and Angelica. Mineshot modifies the camera position/matrix for screenshot purposes, which may conflict with DH's frustum culling or render position calculations.
findings.root_cause: DH's frustum culling and LOD selection is based on camera position. Mineshot changes the camera without DH knowing, causing LODs to be culled incorrectly. The RenderBufferHandler uses frustum culling that may not account for camera overrides.
evidence: RenderBufferHandler.java:138-142: Frustum culling based on camera position
RenderHelper.java:23-24: ClientApi.RENDER_STATE set from Minecraft camera
LodQuadTree.java:68: QuadTree handles LOD selection based on position

primary.issue: Frustum culling may not handle camera overrides
Camera position from MC may not reflect Mineshot override

gap_analysis.current_behavior: LODs disappear when Mineshot overrides camera
gap_analysis.required_behavior: LODs should render correctly with camera override mods
gap_analysis.invariant_violated: Render position should respect camera modifications

proposed_fix.approach: Add compatibility check for camera position override mods, or config to disable frustum culling
implementation_steps: 1. Add config option to disable frustum culling
3. Use actual rendered position instead of player position
proposed_fix.code_changes: Add camera override detection and disable culling when needed

falsification_test.description: If terrain still disappears with culling disabled, issue is in render position calculation
steps: 3. If fixed, culling was the issue
